Adapt To Life symbols

One meaning, one picture, everywhere. Pages ask for the meaning; data/icons.mjs says which drawing it is. Duotone is a section's symbol, regular is chips and row details, bold is where you are, fill is selected. Logos only ever mean a tool or platform.

Drawn from @iconify-json/simple-icons 1.2.101, @iconify-json/material-symbols-light 1.2.98, @iconify-json/ph 1.2.2.
